Free online scoreboard and leaderboard

Keep score on your laptop or phone and show it big on a TV or projector. Leaderboards, rounds, two-team scoreboards and a winner podium — no sign-up needed.

Your data stays on this device. No accounts, no sign-up, nothing is uploaded. Names and scores are stored only in your browser.

Why Punkto

  • Two ways to keep score — A ranked leaderboard for any number of players or teams, or a head-to-head scoreboard for two teams.
  • Rounds, winners and history — Track points per round, finish with a winner podium and keep every result in the history.
  • Made for the big screen — A huge, readable display that updates instantly while you keep score from your laptop or phone.
  • Private by design — Works offline, stores everything locally and backs up via a link or a file — no account, ever.

Questions & answers

Is Punkto really free?

Yes. Every feature is free. Small ads keep the project running — you can hide them for the session for free, or remove them forever with a one-time purchase.

Where is my data stored?

Only in your browser on this device. There are no accounts and no server that receives your boards, names or scores. Use “Copy backup link” or “Export file” to move a board to another device.

How do I show the scores on a TV or projector?

Open your board and click “Display”. A second window opens — move it to the TV or projector and press F for fullscreen. It updates instantly while you change scores.

Does it work offline?

Yes. After your first visit Punkto works without internet. You can also install it as an app from your browser's menu.

Is Punkto GDPR-friendly?

Punkto is built for privacy: no sign-up and no personal data on any server — names stay on your device. With Premium, no third-party ad code is loaded at all.
